name: Beginner Poison
description: Stack Poison debuffs and let them tick for the bulk of your damage while one support keeps the team alive. Forgiving to run on Auto and a good first Clan Boss team for a growing roster.

name: Full Poison Spread
description: Push Poison stacking further with three appliers so the debuff rarely falls off, backed by a single Decrease Defense source to keep each tick hitting hard.

name: Classic HP Burn Nuke
description: Only one HP Burn instance can be active at a time, so this leans on a single strong applier plus Decrease Defense/Weaken to amplify direct hits alongside the burn.

name: Unkillable Nuke
description: A dedicated protection champion keeps the rest of the team alive through Clan Boss's nuke hits while everyone else is built for pure damage, amplified by a debuff layer.

name: Budget Nuke
description: No Legendary poison applier needed — layer Decrease Defense and Weaken to amplify ordinary hits, with a healer to cover the lack of a dedicated protection buff.

name: Myth Seeker (Unkillable)
description: A community-known Epic/Rare 1-key Nightmare/Ultra-Nightmare Clan Boss comp, exactly 4 champions (RSL team leaders must be one of the 4 active fielders, so High Khatun's speed aura requires her to be fielded, not just 'assigned'): High Khatun leads with team speed control, Demytha's Block Damage keeps everyone alive, Seeker pushes turn meters to hold the cycle, and one Poison attacker supplies the damage - Kael also works here if you'd rather trade some of Kalvalax's self-sufficient poison scaling for Kael's higher Accuracy. Needs careful speed tuning (see DeadwoodJedi's Myth Seeker speed-tune page, which describes this as a flexible/interactive comp - the exact 4th slot varies) and solid gear (~3.5k+ DEF) - this is a known comp to aim for, not a guaranteed clear.

name: Full Debuff Stack (AI-designed)
description: An original archetype, not pulled from a community guide: stack Decrease ATK, Decrease DEF, and Weaken together so ordinary hits do outsized damage without needing a dedicated Poison or HP Burn applier at all. Sustained by a Heal source rather than a single point-of-failure Unkillable buff, so it doesn't depend on owning an Ally-Protection specialist - a reasonable next step if your roster is strong on generic debuffers but light on Poison/HP Burn/Unkillable pieces. Unverified against any specific difficulty - treat as a starting point to test, not a guaranteed clear.
